# Fine Art Blogger

> > A comprehensive resource for art enthusiasts and artists exploring painting techniques, art history, and professional practices through essays on famous artists and educational guides.

Fine Art Blogger is run by Jesna, a self-taught oil painter from Kerala with a Computer Science background, offering in-depth analysis of art movements, artist profiles, and practical guidance for both aspiring and established artists. The site covers everything from Impressionism and Renaissance art to contemporary painters, complemented by technical tutorials on color theory and sustainable art practices.

## Key Topics

- Oil Painting
- Art History
- Famous Artists
- Impressionism
- Landscape Paintings
- Renaissance Art
- Color Theory
- Artist Profiles
- Painting Techniques
- Fine Art Analysis
- Artist Marketing
- Sustainable Art Practices
- Contemporary Painters
- Art Movements
- Plein Air Techniques

## Art History & Movements

- [Impressionist Paintings from Famous Artists](https://fineartblogger.com/impressionist-paintings-from-famous-artists): Guide to Impressionism movement featuring Claude Monet and famous works like Impression, Sunrise
- [Henri Matisse](https://fineartblogger.com/henri-matisse): Art history of Fauvism pioneer Henri Matisse and his color theory innovations
- [Hidden Symbolism in Famous Paintings](https://fineartblogger.com/hidden-symbolism-in-famous-paintings): Art analysis decoding hidden symbolism in works by Jan van Eyck, Leonardo da Vinci, and others
- [Famous Christmas Paintings](https://fineartblogger.com/famous-christmas-paintings): Art history of Renaissance Christmas and nativity paintings by Leonardo, Raphael, Botticelli
- [Amazing Candlelight Paintings By Famous Artists](https://fineartblogger.com/candlelight-paintings): Analysis of candlelight paintings by Dutch masters featuring light and composition techniques

## Artist Profiles & Biographies

- [Trent Gudmundsen Paintings](https://fineartblogger.com/trent-gudmundsen): Profile of American figurative oil painter Trent Gudmundsen from Utah and California
- [Fernando Amorsolo Paintings](https://fineartblogger.com/fernando-amorsolo-paintings): Biography and landscape paintings of Filipino artist Fernando Amorsolo
- [Lori Putnam Impressionist Paintings](https://fineartblogger.com/lori-putnam-impressionist-paintings): Profile of contemporary impressionist painter Lori Putnam from Tennessee
- [Tibor Nagy Landscape Paintings](https://fineartblogger.com/tibor-nagy-landscape-paintings): Profile of self-taught Slovak landscape painter Tibor Nagy using plein air techniques
- [Henrik Nordenberg Interior Paintings](https://fineartblogger.com/interior-paintings): Biography and interior paintings by 19th-century Swedish artist Henrik Nordenberg

## Techniques & Education

- [Why color wheel is helpful for artists?](https://fineartblogger.com/color-wheel-helpful-artists): Educational guide on color theory, mixing, and complementary colors using the color wheel
- [Floral Pencil Drawings](https://fineartblogger.com/floral-pencil-drawings): Beginner tutorial on floral pencil drawing with shading and sketching techniques
- [Sustainable Art: Eco-Friendly Practices for Artists](https://fineartblogger.com/sustainable-art-eco-friendly-practices): Guide to eco-friendly art practices using sustainable materials like linen and organic cotton

## Professional Resources

- [The Art of Marketing: Building Relationships with Galleries and Collectors](https://fineartblogger.com/art-marketing-building-relationships-with-galleries): Artist guide to marketing, gallery relationships, networking, and collector outreach
